description: Lora DiCarlo CEO Lora Haddock talks with Recode's Kara Swisher about the process of designing an innovative new sex toy for women — and the fight to get mainstream acceptance for her invention. qualityReason: Original founder interview covering engineering, product development, funding, awards, and commercialization.
